sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
goal: One LuHm app session for optional character-chat and private studio account state, independent of how the application was installed. Do not require every external account just to enter the game.

layers.game: Godot 4, seven-plane glass/HTML cockpit, characters and opt-in device TTS. Identity does not schedule scenes or run AI workers.
layers.identity: One first-party LuHm session broker through reviewed established OIDC/OAuth libraries; not custom cryptographic OAuth or an unverified default provider.
layers.integrations: Separate user-consented provider capability grants, scoped per service and optional.
layers.distribution: Android signed APK/F-Droid-compatible repositories, distinct from authentication.
layers.perimeter: Cloudflare Access for owner/private Zero Trust resources; user app session never bypasses private gate.

google.requiredRegistration: Google Cloud authorized OAuth client and consent configuration

github.origin: GitHub OAuth or preferred fine-grained GitHub App user authorization
github.identityKey: verified numeric GitHub user id returned by authenticated API, not email/display name

apple.origin: Sign in with Apple via Authentication Services (iOS) or approved web JS/REST

identityProtocol.entry: one LuHm sign-in dialog on owner-controlled application origin; optional Google/GitHub/Apple/GitLab choices
identityProtocol.flow: OAuth 2 authorization-code grant with PKCE S256 and vetted provider library; verify exact registered redirect URI
identityProtocol.subjectKey: provider issuer + immutable subject; for GitHub OAuth use verified provider numeric user id
identityProtocol.accountId: opaque LuHm internal user id; no raw identity in character wire packet
identityProtocol.backendSession: Secure HttpOnly SameSite cookie with rotation and server-side revocation; host-specific CSRF defenses; protect native app sessions with platform secure storage

authorizationBoundary.normalGameplay: guest or authenticated LuHm app session; no external repository or media capability by default
authorizationBoundary.cloudSave: signed-in session plus explicit cloud save permission
authorizationBoundary.forgeRead: authenticated user and explicit capability scope; canonical source read lanes preserve existing provider contracts
authorizationBoundary.forgeWrite: deny by default; owner scope+separate consent+verified provider authorization and exact task evidence
authorizationBoundary.systemPortal: independent Cloudflare Zero Trust allowlist, verified JWT and MFA, no implicit access from LuHm game login
authorizationBoundary.renderMcpCurrent: preserve anonymous read-only service at current direct Render HTTPS URL; never replace with HTML OAuth redirect in existing MCP stream
authorizationBoundary.agents: company-wide quarantine remains; no private worker activation from account sign-in
authorizationBoundary.apkRelease: separate signing key and Professor approval, never a login side effect
authorizationBoundary.payment: no implicit paid usage, tokens, or subscriptions
